author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the clearest statement from the people who make everything computer related so prohibitively expensive. Data centres are on the rise and chatbot technology is so prevalent that now these people consider us owning any form of hardware is "inefficient", it should supposedly go to them instead. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: I Hate Him And ChatGPT...
